# Risk minimization on a shared renewal

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`risk-minimization-on-a-shared-renewal` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](risk-minimization-on-a-shared-renewal.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Holders of one generative model, each taking its choice of least risk at its own store, each store at its set point at every step, together end the renewal they share; a member outside a rest that outruns a gated renewal has its need end whatever its model and preference.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Counting helpers: the first element of least score scores no more than any element and is among them (le_of_blt_false, firstMin, firstMin_le, firstMin_mem). (`Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.le_of_blt_false`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.firstMin`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.firstMin_le`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.firstMin_mem`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. A chooser has the amounts it may take, a generative model predicting the level after a step from what it reads and takes, and a preferred level; its risk is the predicted distance from that level (gap), and its choice the first amount of least risk; restraint, taking only nothing, is one chooser (Chooser and six more). 3. <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. For the ending: the World premises (balance, activity needing support, only active giving), the gate at need m, the rest listed without repetition, present where it takes, taking jointly more than a step gives at each of n steps from a level below n + m, and a member outside the rest.
- The chooser's own hypotheses enter no premise of the ending: its takes may be any. The unread law takes need one; at the last outrun step, from a level of at most one, a member outside the rest that takes part takes nothing. The held pair's laws are those of the landed set point, its holders taking part at two steps.
- Modelling choices: a chooser of one step, its model a point prediction with no probability, its risk the distance of the prediction from its preferred level, ties to the earlier amount; natural-number levels and amounts; the holders' stores conditions of the web, the foragers' stores stipulated readings.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That the papers' simulations fail: they have no shared draw.
- Anything of expected free energy beyond risk in counting form: ambiguity, the epistemic term, precision, the softmax over policies, policies over more than one step, learning.
- That a goal over the shared level keeps a collective going: two regulators each counting only its own take continue, three end at the first step.
- That the outrun law forbids the authors' gloss of risk minimization: it forbids only the wording that risk minimization ensures needs are met.
- Who ought to take less, or that the ending is a loss: no evaluation enters.
- **Counterexample:** In the held pair each holder takes its choice of least risk at its own store at no risk at the two steps they take part, each store at its set point at every step, while the pool's renewal ends from step two, unseen by either (held_not_one). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/FreeEnergyGuarantees.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Three regulators of the shared level, each counting only its own take, end at the first step (OneGoal.three_end). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/FreeEnergyGuarantees.lean)
- **Counterexample:** In Exceeding each forager takes its choice of least risk at no risk and its predicted store is kept, while from step two no member is active, the renewer included (alike_not_one, store_kept). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/FreeEnergyGuarantees.lean)
- **Counterexample:** In OneGoal two takers read the shared level and prefer it at four, and every member continues, by what both read of the level (OneGoal.continues). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/FreeEnergyGuarantees.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The commons (Lloyd 1833; Hardin 1968, Science 162) and pivotality (Palfrey and Rosenthal 1984). Against Albarracin and others (2024, Systems 12, 163), where risk minimization ensures that an agent's needs are met, and Friston, Ramstead and others (2024, Collective Intelligence 3) with Da Costa and others (2025, arXiv:2410.00258), where with one generative model and one set of preferences each agent's goal is the group's: read as guarantees, both fail where the rest outruns a gated renewal, or alike preferences are indexical; their simulations have no shared draw (UE1's search, candidates 2 and 3, graded b; candidate 2 weak). Claim 3's forbidding is the landed held pair (what-a-set-point-optimum-does-beyond), here with each take a generative model's least-risk choice; the others apply the outrun law and joint excess. Graded in UE16's NOTE.
